summary: HS 230 cm, 35 deg E glade in a burn at 1984 m, only 130-230 cm dug (lower 130 cm not recorded): 1F- FCxr 130-139 cm under a thin 1 cm 'Jan 24 SH/FC' layer (4F, FC with secondary SH) at 139-140 cm (CT23 SP at 140 cm), RG/FCxr 140-168 cm (1F to 1F+), a 2 cm P ice-formation layer at 168-170 cm, RG 170-199 cm (4F+ to 1F), 4F DF 199-219 and F PP 219-230
reading_issues: Height-axis chart with axis break: blue 'PIT 130' line and zig-zag mean the pit bottom is 130 cm above ground (HS 230, 100 cm dug). Heights calibrated on the 10 cm gridlines (12.63 px/cm); all layer boundaries land on whole cm. Layout has Name / Grain Form columns on the left with bars growing rightward (ticks F/4f/1f/P/K left to right, non-uniform spacing, piecewise-linear interpolation). Profile Name is blank ('--'), so the site name comes from the filename; header elevation is 1984 m while the filename says 2000 m (header recorded). Header surface grain is blank (null) although the top layer glyph is PP. The filled-bar glyph at 168-170 cm read as IF (ice formation) per the TRANSCRIBE table. Dome-on-box glyph read as FCxr. Two layers have tapered hardness bars (layer means recorded, end values in comments). Grain sizes not entered. No temperature profile. Notes: 'Small glade in a burn'.
